steps.title: Reach out
steps.detail: Call the center or send us a message through this website. Tell us your child's name and age and when you would like to visit.

steps.title: Schedule a visit
steps.detail: We will set an appointment at a time that works for your family.

steps.title: Tour and talk
steps.detail: You will see the classrooms, meet the team, review our philosophy, and ask anything you like. We will discuss your child's needs, habits, and development.

steps.title: Complete the application
steps.detail: We will walk you through the enrollment paperwork and the documents we need on file.

steps.title: Arrange assistance if needed
steps.detail: If you are using a childcare subsidy or an assistance program, we will help you request or transfer it.

steps.title: Confirm your start date
steps.detail: Submit the deposit with your start date and the initial tuition, and your child's first day is set.
